instrumentation.canonical: top-level perf_counter_ns plus final torch.npu.synchronize() completion fence; no profiler or internal monkeypatch
instrumentation.diagnostic: post-canonical one-shot torch.npu.Event pairs bracketing the Prefill and Decode NPUEagerBeamStageRunner stages on the engine compute stream; hardware-unvalidated first draft modeled on the GPU CUDA-event code

phase_definition.e2e: instrumented direct beam_search_v1 call start through return
phase_definition.prefill: torch.npu.Event interval on the engine compute stream: entry to the PREFILL NPUEagerBeamStageRunner.execute through output-producing PREFILL sample completion; excludes frontend dispatch
phase_definition.decode: torch.npu.Event interval on the engine compute stream: entry to the first DECODE NPUEagerBeamStageRunner.execute through the last Decode sample completion; excludes Prefill by stream ordering and includes device idle inside Decode
phase_definition.prefill_gpu_compute: sum of the torch.npu.Event interval bracketing the PREFILL execute (model forward plus compute_logits) and the output-producing sample window; excludes dispatch and the execute-to-sample gap
phase_definition.decode_gpu_compute: sum of per-stage torch.npu.Event intervals covering each Decode execute and the sample/beam-advance window; excludes CPU prepare and inter-stage queue gaps
phase_definition.device_idle: device stage span minus the measured NPU compute clusters; a residual rather than an independent measurement, holding CPU launch bubbles, queue waits, and any NPU work outside those windows
phase_definition.prefill_dispatch: host wall from the post-synchronize submit anchor through entry to the PREFILL NPUEagerBeamStageRunner.execute; a subset of host_overhead
phase_definition.prefill_cpu_lead: host look-ahead depth: how far the CPU had advanced into first-Decode preparation before the NPU finished Prefill
phase_definition.host_overhead: e2e minus both device intervals: frontend dispatch, EngineCore queueing, and terminal collection
phase_definition.prefill_output_consumed: diagnostic only: submit boundary through completion of the output-producing PREFILL sample; the NPU runner has no separate async output queue, so this marks the same boundary as Prefill sample completion
phase_definition.average: arithmetic mean over post-canonical diagnostic observations
phase_definition.decode_cache_semantics: common phase; miss/hit are repeated observations, not additive components
phase_definition.device_state_semantics: Prefill and Decode are NPU device-timeline intervals on a single FIFO compute stream; they are additive and sum with host_overhead back to e2e. Hardware-unvalidated first draft.

phase_definition.e2e: unmodified direct GRLLM.beam_search_v1 call start through NPU-complete return
phase_definition.cache_protocol: paired cold miss followed by identical warm hit
phase_definition.internal_stages: reported separately from post-canonical diagnostic samples
